# Zee Zest

> > Zee Zest explores India's culinary heritage, regional traditions, and cultural experiences with a focus on food, beverages, and lifestyle.

Zee Zest is a digital platform celebrating Indian gastronomy and cultural diversity. The site features articles on traditional foods, regional beverages, travel destinations, and local customs across the Himalayas and other Indian regions.

## Key Topics

- Himalayan fermented beverages
- Traditional Indian alcohol
- Chaang (Himalayan millet beer)
- Tongba (Sikkimese hot beverage)
- Lugdi (Himachali fermented drink)
- Regional spirits of India
- Ladakh cuisine and culture
- Sikkim traditional drinks
- Himachal Pradesh local brews
- Darjeeling and Kalimpong beverages
- Indigenous fermentation techniques
- Mountain communities of India
- Cultural food heritage

## Traditional Beverages & Fermented Drinks

- [5 Fermented Beer-like Drinks Made In The Himalayas](https://test.zeezest.com/food/5-fermented-beer-like-drinks-made-in-the-himalayas-zee-zest-341): Himalayan fermented drinks: Chaang, Apong, Tongba, Lugdi & Kiad from India
